model_selection: Original frozen HF253 E0-E1 hazard grid/posterior only; Gamma and exposure corrections do not refit hazards. No external outcome used to choose a model, hazard, cap, alignment rule, or correction.

HF453.risk_set: Recorded A/AU in July 2021; unique confirmed HF253 E0-E1 stem/tree/species association, alive E0, E1 observed DBH at least10. Unlinked or ambiguous units retained in exclusion ledger, not imputed.
HF453.identity: Exact recorded StemTag to HF253 stem.tag or documented composite tag+stem.tag; raw strings retained. Pure integer tag labels additionally compared after leading-zero normalization. Accept only one consistent linked stem across candidate keys. Collisions never broken by outcome, species or mortality prediction.
HF453.duplicate_policy: Exact duplicate rows collapse with provenance; nonidentical same-tag/year rows exclude affected identity from primary scoring.
HF453.reversal_policy: A securely dead DC/DS followed by A/AU is an inconsistent history excluded from primary scores, separately inventoried. DN alone never establishes biological death.
HF453.time: Raw year supplies July precision only. Primary annual exposure is the recorded year difference, an explicitly declared anniversary approximation. Sensitivity spans July1-to-July31 endpoint combinations; no fabricated exact observation date.
HF453.prediction: Sum_h frozen posterior_c(h)*exp(-h*duration), with c from original E0 ancestor cell. Conditional2021-to2024 test, left-truncated to observed2021 survivors; no 2020-to2021 claim.
status_sensitivity: DN treated as surviving for endpoint ambiguity bound
scores: log score with probabilities clipped only for numeric evaluation1e-15
HF453.uncertainty: 1000 whole-spatial-cluster bootstrap replicates preserving complete histories of linked stems within original HF253 quadrat. Also report stem-history bootstrap sensitivity. Missing quadrat gets explicit stratum cluster, never invented positions. Conditional descriptive uncertainty, not unbiased ecological population inference.

HF355.unit: Recorded seedlingID within recorded1m2 subplot; no whole-plot expansion
HF355.support: Only sampled=1, observed dated Y/N visits enter primary adjacent-visit survival; all missing visits and undated records inventoried. Graduation is field-defined above1cm, not entry to whole-plot1-10cm carrier.
HF355.identity: Repeated seedlingID retained; inconsistent coordinate/taxon or nonidentical duplicate visit excludes affected identity from primary transitions, retained in ledger. Taxon-code table supplies documented botanical crosswalk only.
HF355.recruitment: Tabulate first-recorded trueRecrt by cohort year, excluding baseline2017 from post-baseline recruitment fractions. Field interpretation, not germination timestamp or whole-plot biological threshold-entry identity.
outcomes: first recorded graduation and exposure interval
HF355.model_comparison: No fitted seedling-specific hazard exists in original model. Report matched-support descriptive transitions and only explicitly declared four-taxon hazard extrapolation as sensitivity, never primary validation of the below1cm process.
HF355.uncertainty: 1000 subplot-cluster bootstrap replicates retaining all repeated seedling visits; exact record count/exclusion reconciliation

independence: Later external observations evaluate frozen earlier-fit component laws retrospectively; no claim of publicly timestamped prospective issuance or full Health validation.
obstruction: Record-level counts/reasons if linkage/support fails; no substitute data invented
